Container.Name: influxdb
Container.Overview: InfluxDB is an open source time series database with no external dependencies. Useful for recording metrics, events, and performing analytics. This template targets InfluxDB 2.x - note the public CA InfluxDB template (atribe/unRAID-docker) predates v2 and targets the old 1.x layout (port 8083, single /var/lib/influxdb volume), so it is not compatible with this setup.
Container.Requires: First-run setup (admin user/org/bucket) happens via the web UI on first boot unless DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_* env vars are set.

Config.Name: WebUI/API
Config.Description: HTTP API and web UI port
